_comment: User-level config: copy to ~/.config/claude-qa-manager/config.json. It applies to every repository you review; a project's .claude/skills/qa-cycle/config.json overrides it key by key. Every block is optional -- delete what you do not need.

qa_agent._comment: The separate QA account that posts round notes and approves. Store its token with /qa-init; never put the token here.

second_opinion._comment: Extra reviewers from other model providers, used by --double/--triple/--reviewer. api_key_env names the environment variable that holds the key.

flags._comment: Flags you would otherwise type on every /qa-cycle. The command line still wins: --single, --interactive. --auto-approve cannot be defaulted.
